text: dsh-tool-reading-map 是一个面向 DSH 的代码仓库阅读地图工具，通过注册 reading_map 工具，让 agent 在编辑陌生仓库前查看按优先级排列的文件概览。它扫描目录，将配置和入口文件排在前面，再列出代码文件，并提供语言、角色、行数及有限预览；结果还说明候选文件、保留文件和跳过内容，便于识别覆盖范围。用户可指定仓库路径、文件数量上限、预览行数和单文件大小上限。适合希望先快速了解代码库结构的 DSH 用户，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-tool-reading-map adds a DSH reading_map tool that scans a repository and returns a priority-ranked file overview with previews and coverage details. Set the path and scan limits to map an unfamiliar codebase before editing. No API key or external service is required.
想先看陌生代码库里哪些文件最值得读。
让 DSH 扫描项目目录并告诉我扫描遗漏了什么。
I want a ranked map of a repository before an agent edits it.
dsh-tool-reading-map 的功能「生成仓库阅读地图」：调用 reading_map 工具并传入仓库绝对路径，即可获得按配置、入口、代码等角色排序的文件清单，包含语言、行数和预览，并附带被跳过或截断内容的覆盖统计。

dsh-tool-reading-map README · dsh-tool-reading-map：English | [中文](README_CN.md)

A `reading_map` tool plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`). Before the agent edits an unfamiliar codebase, give it a structured, priority-ranked map of the repo instead of letting it wander file by file.

dsh-tool-reading-map README · What it does：- **Priority-ranked file list** — config files and entrypoints first, source code before docs, each entry with language, role (`config` / `entrypoint` / `code` / `other`), line count, size, and a bounded preview. Config and entrypoint files are kept whole.
- **Honest coverage account** — every run reports how many candidate files existed, how many were kept, which directories were skipped, and which files were dropped for being oversized, binary, minified, or over the file cap. A partial map never pretends to be complete.
- **Deterministic** — the scan never calls a model. It is cheap, fast, and identical on replay; the agent summarizes from the map itself when it wants prose.
dsh-tool-reading-map README · What it does：The ranking and skip heuristics are ported from [RepoWiki](https://github.com/he-yufeng/RepoWiki)'s scanner, battle-tested on thousands of repos.

dsh-tool-reading-map README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:he-yufeng/dsh-tool-reading-map
```

or from npm (once published):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-tool-reading-map
```

Boot the profile and the tool appears as `reading_map` alongside the built-ins.

dsh-tool-reading-map README · Tool reference：| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | — | Absolute path of the repository root to scan. |
| `max_files` | number | no | 60 | Files kept after priority ranking (`config` > `entrypoint` > `code` > `other`). |
| `preview_lines` | number | no | 30 | Preview lines kept per non-config, non-entrypoint file. |
| `max_file_size` | number | no | 204800 | Per-file size cap in bytes; larger files are counted as oversized and skipped. |

dsh-tool-reading-map README · Tool reference：The result is one canonical JSON value: `{ root, coverage: { candidates, kept, skippedDirs, oversizedCount, oversized, binaryCount, minifiedCount, priorityDropped }, files: [...] }`, so it composes cleanly with PTC mode and other tooling.

What gets skipped, in one table:

dsh-tool-reading-map README · Tool reference：| Skipped | How it is detected |
|---|---|
| Dependency / build dirs | `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `vendor`, `.venv`, `target`, caches, and more (see `SKIP_DIRS` in `src/scanner.ts`) |
| Assets and lock/binary ext | images, media, archives, fonts, compiled artifacts, `.map`, `.min.js`, `.lock` |
| Oversized files | larger than `max_file_size` (counted, first three named) |
| Binary files | NUL byte within the first 8 KiB |
| Minified source | single line over 1000 chars, or ≤5 non-empty lines with a giant longest line |
| `.gitignore` paths | root `.gitignore` globs (no negation support, by design) |

dsh-tool-reading-map README · Real output (run against the RepoWiki repo)：```text
Reading map of /path/to/RepoWiki: kept 60/78 candidate files, 15 dirs skipped, 12 dropped by priority.
- [config] .env.example (text, 14 lines)
- [config] frontend/package.json (json, 33 lines)
- [config] frontend/tsconfig.json (json, 22 lines)

Skipped on this run (the honest part): `.git`, `.venv`, `dist`, `frontend/node_modules`, every `__pycache__`, plus 12 lower-priority files dropped past the cap — all named in `coverage`, never silently missing.

text:
dsh-tool-reading-map README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run build     # tsc -> lib/
npm test          # vitest
```

Layout:

```
src/
  index.ts    # plugin entry: name / inject / apply
  tool.ts     # reading_map tool definition
  scanner.ts  # the walk, ranking, skip rules, and coverage accounting

Load it from a checkout during development with a patch overlay (absolute path):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: reading-map
      name: /absolute/path/to/dsh-tool-reading-map/lib/index.js
```

`pnpm dsh web --patch ./cordis.dev.yml`
